name: Lucifer
passives: Blood Contract: Lucifer gains Debtfire when defender play anchors a control zone and converts enemy commitment into mitigation on contract-scorched court ground. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a debt, clause, and dominion law rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Infernal Dominion.
lore: Lucifer, Morningstar Thronebreaker, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Infernal Dominion. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: fallen morningstar prince, infernal sovereignty, beautiful rebellion and throne defense. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses fallen morningstar prince, infernal sovereignty, beautiful rebellion and throne defense; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Infernal Dominion canon.
visualDescription: Lucifer manifests as fallen morningstar prince, infernal sovereignty, beautiful rebellion and throne defense from Infernal Dominion: beautiful aristocratic masculine devil face, sharp cheekbones, pale fire eyes, elegant cruel mouth; tall lithe masculine prince build, broad tailored shoulders, narrow waist, predatory upright grace; signature silhouette: high horns, torn royal wings, star-sword, black crown outline. Weapon: black star longsword and obsidian contract shield. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Lucifer — Black-Iron Clause Cut Anchor
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Infernal Dominion source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Contract Debt gain when used from black-iron contract ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchy, ash velvet, hellfire clauses.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Blood-Wax Contract Technique — Bastion
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to protects a control zone, redirects enemy intent, and turns correct positioning into mitigation. Builds Contract Debt only when the Avatar uses black-iron contract ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Lucifer: Infernal Debt Verdict Holdfast
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Contract Debt to impose a two-round rule from Infernal Dominion: protects a control zone, redirects enemy intent, and turns correct positioning into mitigation. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Hell-Crown Dominion Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Contract Debt, transform nearby terrain into black-iron contract ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Lucifer Bulwark Goetic Chain-Crown Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through black-iron contract ground. Visual: black iron crowns, volcanic glass, contract parchment, chain mantles, blood wax seals, horn hierarchy, ash velvet, hellfire clauses.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Lucifer Volcanic Glass Debtor Plate
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Infernal Dominion source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the Avatar followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Lucifer Blood-Wax Infernal Ledger Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Contract Debt and unlocks a mastery branch for Infernal Clause Step, Chain-Lien Reversal, and Collect the Soul Clause. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Lucifer's Blood Contract: a solo mechanic where Debtfire grows through contract-scorched court ground, reaction-window mastery, and defender decisions that anchor a control zone and convert enemy commitment into mitigation. Payoff: hold objectives longer while redirecting the next revealed enemy intent. Counterplay: spread attackers, displacement, or terrain denial break the anchor; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: spread attackers, displacement, or terrain denial break the anchor
